The main takeaway from our work is that

the Stark broadening is the main broadening mechanism of Balmer series lines in the plasma of laser ablation of a carbon target in the range 10 ^{18} –10 ^{19} cm ^{−3}, while the broadening by Doppler and collisional effects is negligible.
